todds_pov: Strategic threat to Genius: unlike Toast/PAR’s stack-consolidation model, DoorDash can become the customer operating system above someone else’s restaurant operating system, potentially reducing the strategic value of POS-native loyalty/CRM. Genius should emphasize openness so customers can connect DashOS/SevenRooms, Olo, Punchh, Como or other engagement layers without operational friction. Watch whether DashOS actually replaces vendors and reduces total cost/complexity, plus the commercial terms governing restaurant customer-data access, portability and use.
